verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's own marketing claims you can build "beautifully branded job boards with ease, no coding or developer required." That covers the branded, no-engineering core of the story. The Job Board API, which exposes published jobs as JSON for custom careers pages, is a developer building block that requires engineering, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: evidence that the board is hosted on the customer's own custom domain, documentation of how jobs auto-publish from the ATS to the hosted board, in-depth first-party docs beyond a marketing one-liner, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work
